meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行审计代码库，发现漏洞并验证可利用性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对代码库进行深度安全审查并验证漏洞可利用性
copy.tagline_en: Audit codebases in parallel, find vulnerabilities and verify exploitability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need deep security review of codebases with exploitability validation

howto.what: Claude 会组织 3 个漏洞猎人和 2 个 PoC 工程师，并行审计代码库，验证漏洞是否真正可利用，分类根因，并基于实际可利用性判定漏洞严重程度。最终输出一份安全研究报告，包含风险判定、发现列表和修复建议。
howto.when: 当你说出“security research”、“security review”或“vulnerability audit”等关键词，或要求进行安全审查、漏洞审计时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一次安全研究，审计当前代码库。
say.note: Claude 会启动团队模式，并行扫描漏洞并验证。

say.text: 分析这个 pull request 的漏洞风险。
say.note: Claude 会对比变更代码，找出可能的利用点并尝试复现。

say.text: 执行安全审计，找出可利用的漏洞并验证。

howto.what_en: Claude orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers in parallel to audit a codebase, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity based on actual exploitability. It outputs a security research report with verdict, findings, and fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', or similar keywords, or ask for a security audit.

say_en.text: Run a security research on the current codebase.
say_en.note: Claude starts team mode to scan and verify vulnerabilities in parallel.

say_en.text: Audit this pull request for vulnerability risks.
Perform a security audit and validate exploitability.
